scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.android:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:build && npx cap open android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run android:build && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run android:build && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.apk: npm run apk:release && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$pkg=(Get-Content package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json); $build=[int]$pkg.buildNumber; $dest='dist/apk'; if (!(Test-Path $dest)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest -Force }; $name=\"xushuo-v$build.apk\"; Copy-Item 'android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk' -Destination \"$dest/$name\" -Force; Write-Host \"APK copied to: $dest/$name\""
